sources.title: Sapiens begins global layoffs as new owner Advent reshapes the company | CTech
sources.description: The software company is laying off about 10% of its global workforce following its $2.5 billion acquisition by Advent. The cuts in Israel will be relatively modest, around 5%, while layoffs in India and the US will reach about 10% of employees. “Sapiens remains deeply committed to its Israeli site, which is central and critical to the company,” said Ernesto Marinelli, Chief People Success Officer at Sapiens.
